_comment: Machine-readable handoff contract for RLinf / IsaacLab. Authoritative prose: ACTION_CONTRACT.md. Do not edit one without the other.
_status: SFT pipeline validated end-to-end; the checkpoint below is a 20-step SMOKE artifact, NOT a trained policy. Replace checkpoint_path after a real SFT run.
checkpoint_path_note: No trained checkpoint exists yet. The 20-step smoke run wrote final_model/pytorch_model.pt (4.2 GB) and it was DELETED afterwards per checkpoint-retention discipline - it had no policy value. A real SFT run writes to <run_dir>/final_model/pytorch_model.pt; set this field then.
degenerate_dims_note: q01 == q99 for these; Normalizer.forward passes them through UNNORMALIZED (raw units). Model output for these dims is already physical, not in [-1,1].
controller_expectation: downstream PD position controller tracks these targets
execution_semantics: predict 30 absolute targets (0.6 s), execute open-loop, then re-plan

navigate_command.note: vx, vy, vyaw; ALL ZERO in this dataset (stationary task)

state_unmapped_note: observation.state[29:63] is 34 tactile channels, IDENTICALLY ZERO in all 45938 frames. Excluded.
task_string: pick up the piston with the right hand, inject it into the tube held by the left hand, then move it over the hole plate.
dataset_origin: IsaacLab replay of piston CSV trajectories (replay_piston_csv.py); all episodes success=true

server_protocol._note: Per the reference checkpoint README; NOT verified in this pass - no deployment run was performed.
server_protocol.known_issue: upstream PolicyNormProcessor may raise 'Video key ego_view not found' for data configs with video augmentation (ours has it); the reference ships policy_norm_processor_PATCHED.py. UNVERIFIED here.

unresolved: No closed-loop evaluation was performed. No policy-quality claim is made.

Whether the RLinf/IsaacLab controller requires proprioceptive state input. If yes, wire StateActionDropout before enabling state.
